definitions.explanation: A bright yellow spice ground from the root of the turmeric plant, used to color and flavor curry powder and rice dishes; also called {鬱金|うこん} in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ターメリック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
ターメリックライス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧。
カレー{粉|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ターメリックによるものだ。
examples.english: The yellow color of curry powder comes from turmeric.

notes:
ターメリック (from English "turmeric") is a bright yellow ground spice, one of the main components of curry powder. It is also known by its Japanese name {鬱金|うこん}, which appears on health-food packaging and in traditional herbal-medicine contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ターメリックライス: turmeric rice (yellow rice)
- ターメリック⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: turmeric color (a golden yellow)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鬱金|うこん}: turmeric — the traditional Japanese name, used more in medicinal or health contexts than in everyday cooking, where ターメリック is standard
